{"text":"ItemID: NA; Title: Imagine; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Familiar classic rock fits my listening, but I am more interested in blues right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: To All The Girls...; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Country collaborations could suit my interest in Blown Away, but I would pass this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Wallflower; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am looking for guitar-driven rock or blues rather than a softer vocal album today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Different Shades Of Blue; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Blues guitar feels like a promising follow-up to Old Sock and People, Hell & Angels; I would try this one.
ItemID: NA; Title: 25; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Contemporary vocal pop is less connected to what I want from this listening session.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Mamas & the Papas - Greatest Hits; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Classic songwriting appeals, but I am not looking for a greatest-hits collection today.
ItemID: NA; Title: 50th Anniversary Collection; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Without an artist name, I cannot tell whether this collection matches my interests.
ItemID: NA; Title: Definitive Collection; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The title alone gives me too little information to make this worth exploring right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Duets: Re-Working The Catalogue; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Reinterpretations of established songs sound potentially appealing, but not enough to choose over blues today.
ItemID: NA; Title: I Still Do; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: More Eric Clapton fits my interest in Old Sock, but I would keep this visit to one selection."}
